title: Topic 3
japanese_text: ただいま、開店セール実施中！ 欲しかったあの商品を<u>お値打ち</u>価格で！さらに、ポイント20％<u>還元</u>キャンペーン、<u>先着</u>100名様限定プレゼントも実施しております。
english_translation: We're having an opening sale right now! Purchase that product you want at a great value price! In addition, we are offering a 20% points return campaign and a limited gift for the first 100 customers to arrive.
